question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He generally avoids arguments as he is _____ by nature.
solution:
```html

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"peaceful"** means free from disturbance; tranquil. (शांत)
 
 
• **Example: **She enjoys the peaceful atmosphere of the countryside.
 
 
 
• **"Peaceful"** refers to someone who prefers harmony and avoids conflict. (शांतिप्रिय)
 
 
• **Example: **He generally avoids arguments as he is peaceful by nature.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.
